prompt: A iridonian reek (IridonianReek), a Star Wars canon creature. Reek could be found on the planets Iridonia, Kashyyyk, Ithor, Codian Moon, Tatooine and Saleucami (to name just a few). Various subspecies invariably sprung up as the base stock adapted to new environments. The Iridonian Reek was bred as a 'war mount' by the Iridonian Zabraks. Instead of giving them a meat diet, the Iridonian reeks were given a natural diet consisting of plant matter to keep them  RimWorld top-down pawn sprite, desert-world creature, painterly game-art style matching the existing RimWorld/Star Wars mod roster, clean silhouette, transparent background.
style_notes: RimWorld creature sprite, Star Wars desert bestiary, our own art (not the donor mod's).
